Barbell_Squat: Rest the bar on your upper back, unrack it and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Breathe in, brace your abs and lower by pushing your hips back and down, knees in line with your feet.
Go as low as you can keep your back neutral and stand up by pushing the floor away with your whole foot.
Barbell_Hack_Squat: Stand with the bar on the floor behind your heels. Squat down with a straight back and grab it behind you with your palms facing back.
Stand up by extending your legs and hips, keeping the bar against the back of your legs.
Lower with control by bending your knees until the bar almost touches the floor.
Barbell_Side_Split_Squat: With the bar on your upper back, take a very wide stance.
Bend one knee and shift your hips to that side, keeping the other leg straight.
Return to the centre by pushing through the bent leg. Alternate, or finish one side and switch.
Barbell_Step_Ups: With the bar on your upper back, stand facing a stable bench or box.
Place one whole foot on top and step up by pushing through that leg, without pushing off with the bottom one.
Step down with control. Use a low height and a light weight until you master the balance.
Box_Squat: Place a box or bench behind you at a height where your thighs are parallel to the floor. Rest the bar on your upper back.
Lower by pushing your hips back until you sit gently on the box, without dropping.
Hold the tension for a moment and stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
Cable_Deadlifts: Attach a short bar or rope to the low pulley and stand facing it, one step away.
With a straight back, bend your hips and knees and grab the attachment.
Stand up by extending your legs and hips and lower again with control, pushing your hips back.
Cable_Hip_Adduction: Attach an ankle strap to the low pulley and put it on the ankle nearest the machine.
Standing tall and holding the machine, bring your leg inwards, crossing it in front of the other.
Return with control. Do all the reps and switch legs.
Chair_Squat: Stand in front of a stable chair or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower by pushing your hips back until you brush the seat, chest up.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot without sitting all the way down. It is a good way to learn the squat.
Clean_Pull: Set up as for a deadlift, with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift the bar close to your legs and, as it passes your knees, extend your hips, knees and ankles explosively while shrugging your shoulders.
Do not bend your elbows: the goal is the explosive extension. Lower the bar with control.
Clean_from_Blocks: Set the bar on blocks at knee height or slightly higher.
Extend your hips and legs explosively and drop under the bar to catch it on your shoulders with your elbows high.
Stand up. It is a technical lift: learn it with a coach.
Clean: Set up as for a deadlift, with the bar over the middle of your feet.
Lift it close to your legs and, as it passes your knees, extend your hips and legs explosively.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a front squat, elbows high, then stand up.
It is a very technical lift: learn it with a coach and a light weight.
Clean_Deadlift: Set up as for a clean: bar over the middle of your feet, grip slightly wider than your shoulders and back straight.
Lift the bar close to your legs, keeping the same torso angle until it passes your knees.
Finish standing and lower with control. It strengthens the first part of the clean.
Dumbbell_Rear_Lunge: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Take a long step back and lower until your back knee almost touches the floor.
Push through the front leg to return to the start and alternate legs. It is usually kinder to the knee than the forward lunge.
Dumbbell_Squat_To_A_Bench: Stand in front of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower by pushing your hips back until you brush the bench, chest up.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot without sitting down.
Elevated_Back_Lunge: Stand on a low platform or plate with the bar on your upper back.
Step back to the floor and lower until your back knee almost touches it.
Come back up by pushing through the leg on the platform. The height lets you go lower.
Frankenstein_Squat: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders and stretch your arms out in front without holding it.
Squat down keeping your torso very upright so the bar does not fall.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot. It teaches the front squat position; use a light weight.
Front_Squat_Clean_Grip: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders, holding it with your fingers, elbows high.
Lower with your torso as upright as possible and your elbows up.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot without letting your elbows drop.
Front_Squats_With_Two_Kettlebells: Hold a kettlebell in each hand resting on your forearm at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest up and your elbows close to your body.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
Hack_Squat: Get into the machine with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads. Feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the platform.
Push through your whole foot until your legs are almost straight and put the safeties back on when you finish.
Hang_Clean: Stand with the bar in your hands in front of your thighs.
Lower the bar to just above your knees by pushing your hips back.
Extend your hips and legs explosively, drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders with your elbows high.
It is technical: learn it with a coach.
Hang_Clean_-_Below_the_Knees: Stand with the bar in your hands in front of your thighs.
Lower the bar to just below your knees by pushing your hips back, with a straight back.
Extend your hips and legs explosively and catch the bar on your shoulders. Learn it with a coach.
Heaving_Snatch_Balance: Rest the bar on your upper back with a very wide grip.
Give a small dip and drive with your legs and push the bar up as you drop into a squat, arms straight.
Stabilise at the bottom and stand up. A technical snatch drill: light weight and supervision.
Hip_Flexion_with_Band: Attach a band to a low point behind you and loop it around your ankle.
Standing and holding on to something stable, raise your knee towards your chest against the band.
Lower with control. Do all the reps and switch legs.
Jefferson_Squats: Place the bar on the floor between your legs, one foot in front of it and the other behind.
Grab it with one hand in front of your body and the other behind.
Stand up with a straight back and lower with control. Switch your foot position between sets.
Jerk_Dip_Squat: With the bar on the front of your shoulders, as for the jerk.
Bend your knees slightly with your torso upright and your weight on your heels.
Straighten your legs forcefully, without pushing with your arms. It trains the drive of the jerk.
Leverage_Deadlift: Stand in the deadlift machine with your feet under the handles.
Bend your hips and knees with a straight back and grab the handles.
Stand up by extending your legs and hips and lower with control.
Lying_Machine_Squat: Lie in the machine with your shoulders under the pads and your feet on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower by bending your knees.
Push until your legs are almost straight without locking your knees.
Narrow_Stance_Hack_Squats: Get into the hack machine with your feet together or nearly together low on the platform.
Lower with control by bending your knees.
Push until your legs are almost straight. The narrow stance loads the outer quads more.
Narrow_Stance_Leg_Press: Sit in the leg press with your feet together in the middle of the platform.
Lower the platform by bending your knees without lifting your hips off the seat.
Push until your legs are almost straight.
Narrow_Stance_Squats: With the bar on your upper back, set your feet closer together than in a normal squat.
Lower with your torso upright and your knees travelling forward.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot. It loads the quads more.
Olympic_Squat: Rest the bar high on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower with a very upright torso to the bottom of the squat, letting your knees travel forward.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot.
Plie_Dumbbell_Squat: Take a very wide stance with your toes turned out and hold a dumbbell with both hands between your legs.
Lower with your torso upright and your knees opening in line with your feet.
Stand up squeezing your glutes and adductors.
Power_Snatch_from_Blocks: Set the bar on blocks at knee height and grab it with a very wide grip.
Extend your hips and legs explosively and take the bar overhead in one movement, catching it in a half squat.
Stand up. It is very technical: learn it with a coach.
Reverse_Band_Box_Squat: Hang bands from the top of the rack and hook them to the bar; they will help you at the bottom.
With the bar on your upper back, lower until you sit gently on a box.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot. For advanced lifters.
Smith_Machine_Leg_Press: Lie under the Smith machine with your feet against the bar.
Release the safeties and lower the bar by bending your knees towards your chest.
Push until your legs are almost straight. Put the safeties back on when you finish.
Smith_Machine_Pistol_Squat: Stand in the Smith machine with the bar on your upper back and one foot forward; stretch the other leg out in front.
Squat down on one leg as far as you can control.
Stand up by pushing through that leg. It is demanding: start with a small range.
Smith_Machine_Squat: Stand under the Smith machine bar, resting on your upper back, with your feet slightly forward.
Release the safeties and lower by pushing your hips back and down.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot and put the safeties back on when you finish.
Smith_Single-Leg_Split_Squat: With the Smith machine bar on your upper back, step one foot forward and leave the other behind.
Lower straight down until your back knee almost touches the floor.
Stand up by pushing through the front leg. Do all the reps and switch sides.
Snatch: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet and a very wide grip.
Lift it close to your legs and, as it passes your knees, extend your hips and legs explosively.
Drop under it and catch it with your arms straight overhead in a deep squat; then stand up.
It is the most technical lift in the gym: learn it with a coach.
Snatch_Balance: Rest the bar on your upper back with a very wide grip.
Push the bar up as you drop into a deep squat, catching it with your arms straight.
Stabilise and stand up. Light weight and supervision.
Snatch_Deadlift: Set up as for a snatch, with a very wide grip and a straight back.
Lift the bar close to your legs until you are standing.
Lower with control. It strengthens the first part of the snatch.
Snatch_Pull: Set up as for a snatch, with a very wide grip.
Lift the bar close to your legs and extend your hips, knees and ankles explosively while shrugging, without bending your elbows.
Speed_Box_Squat: Place a box behind you and use a light weight on your upper back.
Lower with control until you sit on the box and stand up as fast as you can.
Aim for speed, not fatigue: few reps per set.
Split_Clean: Set up as for a clean.
Extend your hips and legs explosively and catch the bar on your shoulders while splitting your legs, one in front and one behind.
Bring your feet together to finish. Learn it with a coach.
Split_Jerk: With the bar on the front of your shoulders, bend your knees slightly.
Drive with your legs and push the bar overhead while splitting your legs.
Stabilise with your arms straight and bring your feet together. Technical: learn it with a coach.
Squat_with_Bands: Hook bands from the bottom of the rack to the ends of the bar.
Do a normal squat: the resistance increases as you stand up.
Drive up hard and lower with control.
Squat_with_Chains: Hang chains from the ends of the bar so they touch the floor when you are at the bottom.
Do a normal squat: the load increases as you stand and the chains lift off the floor.
Drive up hard and lower with control.
Weighted_Jump_Squat: Rest a light bar on your upper back.
Drop into a half squat and jump up explosively.
Land with your knees bent to absorb the impact and go into the next rep. Use a light weight.
Wide_Stance_Barbell_Squat: With the bar on your upper back, set your feet much wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Lower with your torso upright and your knees opening in line with your feet.
Stand up by pushing through your whole foot. It works the glutes and adductors more.
Alternating_Hang_Clean: Hold a kettlebell in each hand hanging between your legs.
With a hip drive, bring one kettlebell up to rest on your forearm at shoulder height.
Lower it and repeat with the other. The kettlebell should roll over your wrist, not bang into it.
Band_Good_Morning_Pull_Through: Anchor a band low behind you and hold it with both hands between your legs.
With your knees slightly bent, push your hips back, letting the band pull your hands backwards.
Extend your hips, squeezing your glutes, to come back up.
Double_Kettlebell_Alternating_Hang_Clean: Hold two kettlebells: one in the rack position on your shoulder and the other hanging between your legs.
With a hip drive, lower the top one while bringing the bottom one up to your shoulder.
Dumbbell_Clean: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Bend your hips and knees slightly and extend explosively to bring the dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Catch them with your knees slightly bent and stand up.
Glute_Ham_Raise: Get into the machine with your ankles secured and your knees just behind the pad.
With your body straight, lower forward until you are parallel to the floor.
Come up by bending your knees with your hamstrings, without bending at the hips.
Good_Morning: With the bar on your upper back and your feet hip-width apart, bend your knees slightly.
Lean your torso forward by pushing your hips back, with a straight back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings and come back up by extending your hips. Use a moderate weight.
Good_Morning_off_Pins: Set the rack pins at the height the bar will be when your torso is bent forward.
Get under the bar, rest it on your upper back and, from the bottom, extend your hips to come up.
Set the bar back on the pins with control.
Hanging_Bar_Good_Morning: Hang the bar from the rack with chains or straps at the height it will be when your torso is bent forward.
Get under it with the bar on your upper back and a straight back, and come up by extending your hips.
Lower again until the weight hangs.
Kettlebell_Dead_Clean: Place the kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
With a straight back, grab it and bring it up with a hip drive to rest on your forearm at shoulder height.
Put it back on the floor and repeat. Switch hands.
Kettlebell_Hang_Clean: Hold the kettlebell hanging between your legs.
With a hip drive, bring it up to the rack position on your forearm, elbow close to your body.
Lower it with control and repeat.
Kettlebell_One-Legged_Deadlift: Stand on one leg with the kettlebell in the opposite hand.
Lean your torso forward while the other leg extends behind you, with a straight back.
Go down until your torso is almost parallel to the floor and come back up squeezing your glute.
Muscle_Snatch: Set up as for a snatch, with a very wide grip.
Extend your hips and legs explosively and take the bar overhead without re-bending your knees.
Finish with your arms straight. Technical: use a light weight.
Natural_Glute_Ham_Raise: Kneel with your ankles secured under something solid or held by a partner.
With your body straight from knees to head, lower yourself forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom and push back up. Very demanding.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Clean: Hold the kettlebell in one hand, hanging between your legs.
With a hip drive, bring it up to rest on your forearm at shoulder height.
Lower it and repeat. Switch hands.
One-Arm_Open_Palm_Kettlebell_Clean: Hold the kettlebell by the handle in one hand, hanging between your legs.
With a hip drive, throw it up, let go of the handle and catch it with an open palm under the bell.
It requires advanced coordination: practise with a light weight and plenty of space.
Power_Clean: Set up as for a deadlift, with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift the bar close to your legs and extend your hips and legs explosively.
Catch the bar on your shoulders in a half squat, elbows high, and stand up.
Technical: learn it with a coach.
Power_Clean_from_Blocks: Set the bar on blocks at knee height.
Extend your hips and legs explosively and catch the bar on your shoulders in a half squat.
Stand up. Technical: light weight and supervision.
Prone_Manual_Hamstring: Lie face down with your legs straight; a partner holds your ankle.
Bend your knee, bringing your heel towards your glute while your partner resists.
Straighten your leg again with control. Switch legs.
Reverse_Hyperextension: Lie face down on the machine or a high bench, hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hold on and raise your straight legs until they are in line with your torso, squeezing your glutes.
Romanian_Deadlift_from_Deficit: Stand on a plate or low platform with the bar in your hands.
With your knees slightly bent, push your hips back and lower the bar close to your legs.
The platform lets you go a little lower; do not round your back. Come back up by extending your hips.
Smith_Machine_Hang_Power_Clean: Stand facing the Smith machine bar and grab it at thigh height.
Extend your hips and legs explosively and bring the bar to your shoulders, rotating your elbows forward.
Smith_Machine_Stiff-Legged_Deadlift: Stand in the Smith machine with the bar in your hands in front of your thighs.
With your knees almost straight, push your hips back and lower the bar.
Go down until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings and come back up.
Standing_Leg_Curl: Stand in the machine with the pad behind your ankle.
Bend your knee, bringing your heel towards your glute, without moving your thigh.
Lower with control. Do all the reps and switch legs.
Stiff-Legged_Barbell_Deadlift: Stand with the bar in your hands in front of your thighs and your knees almost straight.
Hinge forward by pushing your hips back and let the bar travel down close to your legs, with a straight back.
Go down until you feel the stretch in your hamstrings and come back up.
Sumo_Deadlift: Take a very wide stance with your toes turned out and the bar over the middle of your feet.
Grab it inside your legs, arms straight, knees out and chest up.
Stand up by pushing the floor away and driving your knees out. Lower with control.
Sumo_Deadlift_with_Bands: Hook bands from the bottom of the rack to the ends of the bar.
Do the sumo deadlift: the resistance increases as you stand up.
Finish standing, squeezing your glutes, and lower with control.
Sumo_Deadlift_with_Chains: Hang chains from the ends of the bar.
Do the sumo deadlift: the load increases as you stand up.
Finish standing and lower with control.
Wide_Stance_Stiff_Legs: Stand with your feet wide apart and the bar in your hands.
With your knees almost straight, push your hips back and lower the bar with a straight back.
Come back up squeezing your glutes.
Barbell_Glute_Bridge: Lie on your back with the bar over your hips (with a pad), knees bent and feet flat.
Raise your hips by driving through your heels until your knees, hips and shoulders are aligned.
Squeeze your glutes for a second and lower with control.
Butt_Lift_Bridge: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and arms by your sides.
Raise your hips by driving through your heels and squeezing your glutes.
Hold for a second at the top and lower with control.
Flutter_Kicks: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and your legs straight out behind you.
Hold the bench and kick your legs up and down alternately in short movements.
Keep your glutes squeezed throughout the set.
Glute_Kickback: Get on all fours, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Drive one leg back and up, knee bent, until your thigh is in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute and lower with control. Switch legs.
Hip_Extension_with_Bands: Anchor a band low in front of you and loop it around one ankle.
Standing and holding on to something stable, take your straight leg back against the resistance.
Hip_Lift_with_Band: Lie on your back with a band across your hips, held with your hands or anchored to the floor.
With your knees bent, raise your hips, squeezing your glutes.
Kneeling_Squat: Kneel on a soft surface with the bar on your upper back.
Drive your hips forward until you are upright on your knees, squeezing your glutes.
One-Legged_Cable_Kickback: Attach an ankle strap to the low pulley and put it on one ankle. Stand facing the machine.
Holding the machine, take your straight leg back, squeezing your glute.
Return with control. Do all the reps and switch legs.
Pull_Through: Stand with your back to a low pulley with a rope, holding it between your legs.
Take a few steps forward, bend your knees slightly and push your hips back, letting the rope pass between your legs.
Extend your hips forcefully, squeezing your glutes.
Step-up_with_Knee_Raise: Stand facing a stable bench or box.
Step up with one leg and, at the top, raise the opposite knee to hip height.
Step down with control and alternate legs.
Barbell_Seated_Calf_Raise: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a plate and the bar resting on your thighs near your knees (with a pad).
Raise your heels as high as possible.
Lower with control to stretch your calves.
Calf_Press: Sit in the machine with the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform.
Push with your toes, extending your ankles.
Return with control until your calves are stretched.
Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine: Sit in the leg press with your legs almost straight and only the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform.
Push with your toes, extending your ankles, without bending your knees.
Return with control. Do not release the leg press safeties if you do not need to.
Calf_Raise_On_A_Dumbbell: Place the ball of one foot on the handle of a dumbbell on the floor and hold on to something stable.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Dumbbell_Seated_One-Leg_Calf_Raise: Sit with the ball of one foot on a plate and a dumbbell resting on your thigh near the knee.
Raise your heel as high as possible.
Rocking_Standing_Calf_Raise: Stand with the bar on your upper back.
Rise onto your toes and then rock back onto your heels, lifting your toes.
Alternate both movements with rhythm and control.
Smith_Machine_Calf_Raise: Stand in the Smith machine with the bar on your upper back and the balls of your feet on a plate.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower with control to stretch your calves.
Smith_Machine_Reverse_Calf_Raises: Stand in the Smith machine with your heels on a plate and your toes in the air.
Pull your toes up towards your shins.
Lower with control. It works the front of the lower leg.
Band_Hip_Adductions: Anchor a band low to one side and loop it around the nearer ankle.
Bring your leg inwards, crossing it in front of the other.
Return with control and switch sides.
Thigh_Adductor: Sit in the machine with your legs apart and the pads on the inside of your knees.
Bring your legs together, squeezing your adductors.
Monster_Walk: Place a band around your ankles or just above your knees.
In a half squat, walk with short steps forwards and diagonally, keeping the band taut.
Take the set number of steps and walk back.
Thigh_Abductor: Sit in the machine with your legs together and the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your legs apart, squeezing your glutes.
